page.overview:
What is Dimholt?

The Dimholt was a forest situated at the base of the Dwimorberg mountain, past Dunharrow in southern Rohan.

The Dimholt was a forest of pine and fir. Through it an ancient road ran, leading to a glen where a standing stone was placed before the Dark Door. It signified the entrance to the Paths of the Dead.

The path led under Dwimorberg, and was haunted by the spirits of Men of the mountain of the Third Age. Even Legolas, a woodland Elf, could not have endured long under the trees.

Dimholt is a Rohanese word translating approximately to "secret wood".
